units.text: The growth team wants to understand how customers use the Lumen web and mobile apps.
units.topic: Proposal: product-analytics event pipeline (draft v0.3) › Context

units.text: Today, product events are scattered across three logging tools, and nobody can answer a simple funnel question without exporting CSV files by hand.
units.topic: Proposal: product-analytics event pipeline (draft v0.3) › Context

units.text: This proposal describes a single pipeline that collects product-analytics events, enriches them and makes them available in the warehouse.
units.topic: Proposal: product-analytics event pipeline (draft v0.3) › Context

units.text: The first questions the team wants answered are how many new accounts finish onboarding, and which features paying customers use in their first month.
units.topic: Proposal: product-analytics event pipeline (draft v0.3) › Context

units.text: Client SDKs in the web and mobile apps send events to a collector service over HTTPS.
units.topic: Proposal: product-analytics event pipeline (draft v0.3) › Proposed design

units.text: Clients batch events and send them every 10 seconds, or sooner when the app goes to the background.
units.topic: Proposal: product-analytics event pipeline (draft v0.3) › Proposed design

units.text: Each event carries an event name, a timestamp, an anonymous device id and, for signed-in users, an account id.
units.topic: Proposal: product-analytics event pipeline (draft v0.3) › Proposed design

units.text: The collector validates each event against the schema registry and rejects events that do not match a registered schema.
units.topic: Proposal: product-analytics event pipeline (draft v0.3) › Proposed design

units.text: Accepted events are published to the `analytics.events` topic on the message bus.
units.topic: Proposal: product-analytics event pipeline (draft v0.3) › Proposed design

units.text: An enrichment step consumes the topic and adds account attributes, such as plan tier and region.
units.topic: Proposal: product-analytics event pipeline (draft v0.3) › Proposed design

units.text: The enrichment step uses the user service.
units.topic: Proposal: product-analytics event pipeline (draft v0.3) › Proposed design

units.text: If an account cannot be found, the event is passed on without account attributes.
units.topic: Proposal: product-analytics event pipeline (draft v0.3) › Proposed design

units.text: Enriched events are then written to the warehouse in hourly batches, where the analytics team builds dashboards on them.
units.topic: Proposal: product-analytics event pipeline (draft v0.3) › Proposed design

units.text: The first dashboards will cover the onboarding funnel and weekly active accounts per plan tier.
units.topic: Proposal: product-analytics event pipeline (draft v0.3) › Proposed design

units.text: We expect the user service to stay lightly loaded, so enrichment should avoid adding much traffic to it.
units.topic: Proposal: product-analytics event pipeline (draft v0.3) › Proposed design

units.text: Every event type must be registered before clients can send it.
units.topic: Proposal: product-analytics event pipeline (draft v0.3) › Schema registry

units.text: Schemas are versioned, and a breaking change requires a new version rather than an edit to the existing one.
units.topic: Proposal: product-analytics event pipeline (draft v0.3) › Schema registry

units.text: Ownership of the schema registry has not been decided; the platform team and the data team have each suggested the other.
units.topic: Proposal: product-analytics event pipeline (draft v0.3) › Schema registry

units.text: Product managers have asked to see feature adoption as it happens, especially during launches.
units.topic: Proposal: product-analytics event pipeline (draft v0.3) › Freshness

units.text: Launch reviews usually happen within 2 hours of a release.
units.topic: Proposal: product-analytics event pipeline (draft v0.3) › Freshness

units.text: With this pipeline, events reach the warehouse in real time, so launch dashboards stay current.
units.topic: Proposal: product-analytics event pipeline (draft v0.3) › Freshness

units.text: Raw events will be kept for 30 days and then deleted; only aggregated tables are kept longer.
units.topic: Proposal: product-analytics event pipeline (draft v0.3) › Retention and privacy

units.text: Deleting raw events after a fixed period also limits what an access request has to search.
units.topic: Proposal: product-analytics event pipeline (draft v0.3) › Retention and privacy

units.text: How long the aggregated tables are kept is TBD.
units.topic: Proposal: product-analytics event pipeline (draft v0.3) › Retention and privacy

units.text: Events must not contain email addresses or free-text input from users.
units.topic: Proposal: product-analytics event pipeline (draft v0.3) › Retention and privacy

units.text: IP addresses are truncated by the collector before an event is published.
units.topic: Proposal: product-analytics event pipeline (draft v0.3) › Retention and privacy

units.text: This pipeline is not meant for operational monitoring or alerting; error logs and service metrics stay in the existing observability stack.
units.topic: Proposal: product-analytics event pipeline (draft v0.3) › Non-goals

units.text: It will not replace the billing system's records of revenue.
units.topic: Proposal: product-analytics event pipeline (draft v0.3) › Non-goals

units.text: Component | Owner | Retention
units.topic: Proposal: product-analytics event pipeline (draft v0.3) › Components

units.text: Collector | Platform team | none
units.topic: Proposal: product-analytics event pipeline (draft v0.3) › Components

units.text: analytics.events topic | Platform team | 7 days
units.topic: Proposal: product-analytics event pipeline (draft v0.3) › Components

units.text: Enrichment | Data team | none
units.topic: Proposal: product-analytics event pipeline (draft v0.3) › Components

units.text: Warehouse raw events | Data team | 90 days
units.topic: Proposal: product-analytics event pipeline (draft v0.3) › Components

units.text: Schema registry | TBD | indefinite
units.topic: Proposal: product-analytics event pipeline (draft v0.3) › Components

units.text: Phase 1 covers the web app's sign-up and checkout events.
units.topic: Proposal: product-analytics event pipeline (draft v0.3) › Rollout

units.text: Phase 2 adds mobile events once the mobile SDK is ready; no date has been set for it.
units.topic: Proposal: product-analytics event pipeline (draft v0.3) › Rollout

units.text: Phase 1 is expected to take about 6 weeks for 2 engineers.
units.topic: Proposal: product-analytics event pipeline (draft v0.3) › Rollout

units.text: The cost of running the pipeline has not been estimated yet.
units.topic: Proposal: product-analytics event pipeline (draft v0.3) › Rollout

units.text: Who owns the schema registry?
units.topic: Proposal: product-analytics event pipeline (draft v0.3) › Open questions

units.text: What happens to events the collector rejects: are they dropped, or kept somewhere for debugging?
units.topic: Proposal: product-analytics event pipeline (draft v0.3) › Open questions

units.text: Should mobile events use the same schemas as web events?
units.topic: Proposal: product-analytics event pipeline (draft v0.3) › Open questions

units.text: We ask for approval to start phase 1 while the open questions are settled in parallel.
units.topic: Proposal: product-analytics event pipeline (draft v0.3) › Next step
